title: When the Wolf Breaks
author: Astrid Yarrow
blurb: Ansel Okonkwo, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
